name: Customer Support
description: Handle inbound customer messages, ticket triage, sentiment detection, and support workflows. Optimized for high-volume support teams.
target_audience: Support teams handling customer inquiries via messaging

required.reason: Core functionality for categorizing and routing incoming support requests

recommended.reason: Detect frustrated customers early for proactive escalation
Enable self-service by surfacing relevant documentation

optional.reason: Automatically escalate based on keywords, sentiment, or wait time
AI-generated contextual responses (use with caution in production)

posthog.reason: Track response times, resolution rates, and customer satisfaction

moltbook.reason: Useful for connecting with support communities

monitoring.reason: Critical for production support - detect outages immediately

onboarding_questions.question: What's your expected daily message volume?
Do you need automatic escalation to human agents?
Do you have an existing knowledge base to connect?
